meaning.en: BS 1363 socket (Type G, UK 13 A socket with rectangular pins), shown as the socket face seen from the front, earth aperture up
meaning.de: BS-1363-Steckdose (Typ G, britische 13-A-Steckdose mit Flachstiften), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn, Schutzkontakt oben

standard.source: BS 1363-2 not consulted; contact layout taken from the OpenPlugDB front view "BS 1363 socket-outlet (female), mating face, earth aperture up" (https://github.com/ovarilo/openplugdb/blob/main/public/images/connectors/bs-1363/bs-1363-socket-front.svg, retrieved 2026-11-08), drawn from Wikipedia "BS 1363" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BS_1363, retrieved 2026-11-08); WorldStandards "Plug type G" (https://www.worldstandards.eu/electricity/plugs-and-sockets/g/, retrieved 2026-11-08)
